Interface PulsarListenerEndpoint

All Known Implementing Classes:

public interface PulsarListenerEndpoint extends ListenerEndpoint<PulsarMessageListenerContainer>
Model for a Pulsar listener endpoint. Can be used against a PulsarListenerConfigurer to register endpoints programmatically.
